questions.q: What was Tuvalu called as a British colony?
questions.why: It split from the Gilbert Islands in 1975.

questions.q: In which year did Tuvalu become independent?
questions.why: It is in the Commonwealth.

questions.q: Which country lets Tuvaluans move there under a 2023 treaty?
questions.why: It offers residency for climate reasons.

questions.q: Which wartime airstrip was built on Funafuti by US forces in 1943?
questions.why: It is still the only runway.

questions.q: Which national holiday on 1 October marks independence?
questions.why: There are canoe races.

questions.q: What is the capital of Tuvalu?
questions.why: It is an atoll.

questions.q: How many islands make up Tuvalu?
questions.why: 'Tuvalu' means 'eight standing together'.

questions.q: Which ocean is Tuvalu in?
questions.why: It lies between Hawaii and Australia.

questions.q: What is Tuvalu's population roughly?
questions.why: It is one of the least populous countries.

questions.q: Which lagoon conservation area protects Funafuti's wildlife?
questions.why: It covers part of the lagoon.

questions.q: What are Tuvalu's islands made of?
questions.why: They are very low.

questions.q: Which meeting house is the centre of island life?
questions.why: Meetings and dances happen there.

questions.q: Which island is the largest by land area?
questions.why: It has the main secondary school.

questions.q: Which Tuvaluan atoll is the northernmost?
questions.why: It has a large church.

questions.q: Which reef island near Funafuti is home to many seabirds?
questions.why: It is in the conservation area.

questions.q: Which sport is popular on the runway when no planes are due?
questions.why: The airstrip is the biggest open space.

questions.q: Which sport has Tuvalu competed in at every Olympics since 2008?
questions.why: It sends a sprinter.

questions.q: Which foreign minister gave a 2021 climate speech standing knee-deep in the sea?
questions.why: It was filmed for COP26.

questions.q: Who became Prime Minister of Tuvalu in 2024?
questions.why: He had been a Pacific fisheries official.

questions.q: Which currency does Tuvalu use?
questions.why: It also issues its own coins.

questions.q: Which threat could make Tuvalu one of the first countries to disappear?
questions.why: Its highest point is about 4.6 m above sea.

questions.q: Which internet domain earns Tuvalu big money?
questions.why: TV companies use it.

questions.q: Which country does Tuvalu officially recognise instead of China?
questions.why: It is one of few countries to do so.

questions.q: Which Tuvaluan plan is creating a 'digital nation' to save its culture?
questions.why: It would copy the islands into the metaverse.

questions.q: Which traditional dance is performed in Tuvalu?
questions.why: It speeds up as it goes.

questions.q: Which root crop is grown in pits on Tuvalu?
questions.why: Salty water threatens the pits.

questions.q: Which fruit tree is used for food, rope and building?
questions.why: It is called the 'tree of life'.

questions.q: Which language is spoken in Tuvalu besides English?
questions.why: It is a Polynesian language.

questions.q: Which annual stamp sales once supported Tuvalu?
questions.why: Now fishing licences and .tv bring money.

questions.q: What does the country's motto 'Tuvalu mo te Atua' mean?
questions.why: It shows the role of Christianity.
